simple.meaning: לְבוֹנָה (Lᵉbôwnâh) is a Hebrew word meaning “Lebonah , a place in Palestine.” BibleIQ connects the English word back to this source word so its use can be compared across Scripture.

occurrences.englishText: They said, “Behold, there is a feast of Yahweh from year to year in Shiloh, which is on the north of Bethel, on the east side of the highway that goes up from Bethel to Shechem, and on the south of Lebonah.”
